notes.title: Update HotD v1.2
notes.notes:
During the last months we have been doing several changes and fixes but we didn't make an announcement about them because we thought we should finish all the updates first.

So we have added:

- Steam Cards
- Options on Sound and Screen
- Fast forward option on battle
- Quiting in battle is now penalized
- Added several tooltips
- Minor bug fixes

Thank you all for your patience and feedback. We will now do our best to release Mac and Linux versions.

Thank you all
